body:
I'm not sure if it's the right thing to do to add this permission to a manifest of the library that then is automatically merged into an app manifest. Not every app may use the `DownloadService`. 

I think an app that includes the `DownloadService` wants to add this permission, but I also think it  should be left to the app to do that. 

I agree though that we should add this permission to the `AndroidManifest.xml` of the main demo app as an example to do the right thing. Is this what you are asking for?

It was an open question whether a comment should be added to the `abstract class DownloadService` in order to specify that if the permission is not asked for A13+ it won't prompt the notification. 
I agree that handling the permission should fall upon the app using `DownloadService, also yes the demo might need an update regarding this permission.

Ok, makes sense. Currently the main demo app does never show a notification when downloading (when on targetSdkVersion 33). On API 33 it not only requires the permission to be added to the manifest, but instead the permission also needs to be requested at runtime. Aside: The session demo app is not affected by this change because its notification is exempted because it is attached to a media session.

I think we need to do the following things:

1) Document in `DownloadService` that an app with targetSdkVersion 33+ needs to add the `android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS` to the manifest.
2) Document that such an app also needs to request `Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS` at runtime in order to notification to be shown. It's at the app's discretion when to do this, like when the app starts or when a download is triggered.
3) Do point 1) and 2) for the main demo app.
Marking this issue as a bug (in the main demo app) on API 33.

I am in the process of updating to Android Gradle Plugin 7.4. The project I am working on does use ExoPlayer but it does not use `DownloadService`. However, there appears to be a new lint rule added in Android Gradle Plugin 7.4 that is failing for us due to our dependency on ExoPlayer:
```
Error:   /*****/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml: Error: When targeting Android 13 or higher, posting a permission requires holding the POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission (usage from com.google.android.exoplayer2.offline.DownloadService.ForegroundNotificationUpdater) [NotificationPermission]
```

It feels odd to me to have to specify this permission in the app's manifest if the app does not use `DownloadService` at all. We could suppress the lint violation for now but that also seems a little odd to me. 🤷‍♂️ 

Here is a similar/related comment:
https://github.com/digitalservicebund/useid-app-android/pull/132#issuecomment-1443915366

issue.title: Updating dependencies, SDKs, and more

repository.name: kotlin-toolkit
repository.description: A toolkit for ebooks, audiobooks and comics written in Kotlin

issue.body:
**What's been updated**

1. Update all dependencies to latest versions.
2. Update compile and target SDKs to 34.
3. Update Gradle to 8.0, and AGP to 8.1.0.
4. Use Java 17 (required by AGP update).

**Important notes**

1. [KSP](https://developer.android.com/build/migrate-to-ksp) has replaced Kapt for Room. There is an [issue](https://issuetracker.google.com/issues/236612358) with Room 2.5.2 and Kotlin 1.9.0 that won't be fixed until 2.5.3. One of the workarounds in the issue is to use KSP instead of Kapt. Kapt is in maintenance mode and KSP offers significant performance improvements.
2. With Kotlin 1.8, we don't need to declare `kotlin-stdlib-jdk7` or 8 as they have been merged into a straightforward `kotlin-stdlib`. https://kotlinlang.org/docs/whatsnew18.html#updated-jvm-compilation-target.
3. android.nonTransitiveRClass defaults to true with the new AGP version. Because of this, when accessing IDs from external libraries, you have to prefix it with the namespace. For example, `R.id.search_close_btn` is now `androidx.appcompat.R.id.search_close_btn`.
4. If `BuildConfig` is needed for individual modules, `buildConfig = true` must be added to the `buildFeatures` block in build.gradle.kts for that module.

**What else changed**

1. When targeting Android SDK 34 you must add `android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK` in order for TTS or Audiobook playback to work.
